domain: philosophy and practice of scientific discovery, severe testing, error statistics, and adversarial inquiry
axioms: A claim, an operation, and a whole tournament are credible only in proportion to the severity of the test each could have failed.
Retirement is a first-class operation: a system that can only accumulate hypotheses and never kill them is a bias amplifier.
Negative results are durable evidence about source-domain base rates and must be retained rather than erased.
Error correction and generativity compete for the same marginal turn; which one pays depends on task conditions and must be stated, not assumed.
Pre-registration and predeclared losing conditions are what separate a tournament from a rationalization.
The no-S null is itself a hypothesis and must carry a losing condition like any candidate.
primitives: research programme in progressive or degenerating state
failure_mode: Under-generates: prefers killing candidates to producing them, which can starve the field of the twelve required raw candidates.
Can collapse every disconfirmation candidate into Reflect and lose genuinely distinct wide-aperture testing.
Undervalues cheap speculative generation whose payoff is long-tailed and hard to pre-register.
Neglects agent topology, propagation, and pedagogy as legitimate operations.
Tends toward severity theater: demanding falsifiability of design-taste questions where it does not apply, such as mnemonic quality.
